ABOUT AAV WORKS

Architects of Modern
Railway Signalling

Combining global engineering standards with deep indigenous expertise to deliver fail-safe, high-speed, and intelligent rail transit systems across India and beyond.

OUR JOURNEY & VALUES

Driven by Engineering.
Guided by Purpose.

AAV Works Private Limited was founded by a dynamic, result-oriented consortium of senior railway signalling professionals with a shared vision: to elevate India’s railway infrastructure through uncompromising engineering rigor, digital automation, and SIL-4 safety assurance.

Our core competence centers on Railway Signalling & Telecommunication (S&T), Electronic Interlocking (EI) application data, and embedded hardware development. We proudly stand as one of the specialized enterprises in India with profound expertise across all RDSO-approved Electronic Interlocking systems, boasting IRSE (Institution of Railway Signal Engineers) and IRSTELO certifications.

COMPLIANT WITH RDSO • CENELEC EN 50126/128/129 • SIL-4
OUR MISSION

Excellence in Every Circuit

To deliver high-standard systems and challenging solutions that provide superior value to our railway clients, ensuring utmost passenger safety while providing fulfilling, lifelong professional value to our engineers and collaborators.

OUR VISION

A Safer, Smarter Rail Network

To be the recognized leader in providing intelligent, reliable, and economical technological solutions to the sustainable transportation and railway sector globally, setting new benchmarks in automated signalling design.
